meta.name: media-proxy
meta.description: Shared helper that routes ALL paid media generation (FAL image/video, ElevenLabs music) through the GooseWorks proxies so every call bills the Ads agent — never a provider SDK's default host. Host-swaps the FAL queue URLs, loads the agent token from ~/.gooseworks/credentials.json, and returns the result CDN URL. Every video-ad media capability imports this; templates never call a provider directly.

copy.tagline: 路由付费媒体生成请求到代理，统一计费
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在广告场景中统一管理多个媒体生成服务的计费
copy.tagline_en: Route paid media generation requests through proxies for unified billing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to centrally manage billing for multiple media generation services in ad campaigns

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 在生成图片、视频或音乐时，通过代理服务器调用付费 API，确保费用记在广告代理账户上，并返回可公开访问的 CDN 链接。
howto.when: 当 Claude 需要生成广告用的图片、视频或背景音乐时触发。例如，在视频广告制作流程中，Claude 会调用此技能来生成媒体素材。

say.text: 帮我生成一张产品图片，提示词是“红色跑车在公路上行驶”。
根据这张关键帧图片生成一段10秒的视频。
say.note: Claude 会调用视频生成模型，并返回视频链接。

say.text: 生成一段30秒的纯音乐背景，风格轻快。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude route all paid media generation (images, videos, music) through proxy servers so costs are billed to the Ads agent, and returns publicly accessible CDN URLs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude needs to generate images, videos, or background music for ads, typically during video ad creation workflows.

say_en.text: Generate a product image with prompt 'a red sports car on a highway'.
say_en.note: Claude will call FAL via proxy and return a CDN URL.

say_en.text: Create a 10-second video from this keyframe image.
say_en.note: Claude will call the video generation model and return a video URL.

say_en.text: Generate a 30-second instrumental music bed with an upbeat style.
say_en.note: Claude will call ElevenLabs and return an audio URL.
